about: Heavy Slant (katana.k_2l1), the two-handed string's hit 1 (KE task 13): Attack2H01's overhead diagonal, the blade raised over the head and swung round behind it to the right shoulder, then cut down across to the left hip, in Elden Ring's two-handed rhythm (quicker than the one-handed string's): the wind-up (source frames 0-11.5 over 7), the top held, the strike snapped through into the active frames, the follow-through held low on the left to the end, where Left Rise goes on from it. The clip is two-handed already: the left hand is set on the grip and the blade kept clear of the body. A step forward carries the body into the cut. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
